settings.title: Full-service
settings.intro: One team for the whole lifecycle of your rental — from finding the right tenant to keeping the property in shape and the numbers in order.

design.title: Tenant placement
design.text: We market your unit, screen applicants with credit, background, and reference checks, and place a tenant who pays on time and stays.

design.title: Lease management
design.text: Legally sound leases, renewals, and move-in/move-out inspections handled end to end. You never chase a signature or a clause.

build.title: 24/7 maintenance
build.text: Tenants reach our team around the clock. We dispatch vetted vendors, approve costs within your limits, and keep the property in shape.

build.title: Vendor network
build.text: A pre-vetted network of plumbers, electricians, and contractors at negotiated rates — so repairs are fast, fair, and documented.

launch.title: Rent collection
launch.text: Online payments, automatic late fees, and consistent enforcement. Rent lands in your account on time, every month.

launch.title: Owner reporting
launch.text: A clear monthly statement of income, expenses, and occupancy — plus a year-end summary for your accountant. No surprises, no spreadsheets.

settings.title: Onboarded in
settings.intro: Getting your property under management is fast and painless. Here's exactly what happens from first call to first statement.

steps.title: Property review
steps.text: We walk your unit, assess its condition and rental value, and give you an honest picture of what it can earn and what it needs.

steps.title: Pricing & marketing
steps.text: We set a market-smart rent, photograph the unit, and list it across the major platforms to attract qualified applicants fast.

steps.title: Tenant placement
steps.text: We screen, show, and place a vetted tenant, then handle the lease, the deposit, and the move-in inspection.

steps.title: Ongoing management
steps.text: We collect rent, coordinate maintenance, and send you a clear monthly statement. You watch the asset grow from your inbox.

settings.note: Most properties are fully onboarded and listed within two weeks of the first walkthrough. We'll give you a firm timeline up front and stick to it.

settings.title: The difference is
settings.intro: Anyone can collect rent. We run your property like a business — with the systems, the reporting, and the accountability that protect your investment.

features.title: Transparent pricing
features.text: One flat management fee, no hidden charges. You see exactly what you pay and exactly what your property earns.

features.title: Vetted tenants
features.text: Every applicant is screened for credit, criminal history, and references. We place tenants who pay and stay.

features.title: Proactive maintenance
features.text: We catch small issues before they become big bills — seasonal checks, vendor oversight, and documented repairs.

features.title: On-time rent
features.text: Online payments and consistent enforcement mean rent lands in your account on schedule, every single month.

features.title: Clear reporting
features.text: A monthly statement and a year-end summary your accountant will love. Every dollar accounted for.

features.title: Local expertise
features.text: We know the market, the codes, and the contractors. Your property is managed by people who live and work here.

settings.title: Questions owners
settings.intro: Straight answers about fees, tenants, maintenance, and what it's like to hand over your property.

items.question: How much does property management cost?
items.answer: We charge a flat management fee — typically 8–10% of monthly rent depending on the property. There are no hidden charges, no leasing fees on top, and no surprise line items. You'll see the exact fee in your agreement.

items.question: How do you screen tenants?
items.answer: Every applicant goes through a full screening: credit history, criminal background check, employment and income verification, and references from prior landlords. We only place tenants who meet our standards.

items.question: What happens when something breaks?
items.answer: Tenants reach our 24/7 line. We dispatch a vetted vendor, approve costs within the limit you set, and keep you informed. For larger repairs, we get your approval before spending.

items.question: How do I get paid?
items.answer: Rent is collected online and deposited to your account on a set schedule each month. You'll receive a clear statement showing income, expenses, and your net distribution.

items.question: Can I manage my own property and still use you?
items.answer: We offer full-service management only — it's how we keep quality high and protect your investment. If you'd rather stay hands-on, we're happy to point you to the right resources.

settings.title: Let's talk
settings.intro: Tell us about your unit or building and we'll give you an honest assessment of its rental value and what full-service management would look like. No obligation, no hard sell.
